noticias.titulo: IMSS-Bienestar 120-day plan: more than MXN 10.3bn for medical equipment and 100 million medicine pieces
noticias.resumen: On November 11, IMSS-Bienestar presented a 12-action plan for the next 120 days in its 24 member states. It allocates over MXN 5,732m to 212 high-tech units, including 7 linear accelerators, 125 AI-equipped mammographs, 9 MRI and 68 CT scanners, plus MXN 4,658m for beds, monitors, ultrasound and defibrillators. It also plans to distribute 100 million medicine pieces, spend MXN 3,470m on maintaining 244 units and hire 19,314 staff.
noticias.accion: Imaging, radiotherapy, monitoring and hospital-equipment suppliers should track IMSS-Bienestar procurement over the next four months and prepare offers and registrations.

noticias.titulo: Chamber of Deputies approves 2027 federal budget with about MXN 1.105 trillion for health
noticias.resumen: In the early hours of November 11, the Chamber of Deputies approved the 2027 Presupuesto de Egresos de la Federación by 352 votes to 130. Net spending is MXN 10.636 trillion, of which about MXN 1.105 trillion goes to health. The budget now goes to the Executive for publication; no separate figures for IMSS, ISSSTE, IMSS-Bienestar or medicines were reported.
noticias.accion: Use the 2027 health budget to plan public-sector sales and look for the institution-level breakdown once it is published in the DOF.

noticias.titulo: National Compendium of Health Inputs updated with new oncology drugs, a breast biopsy system and a temperature management device
noticias.resumen: The Consejo de Salubridad General published an update to the Compendio Nacional de Insumos para la Salud in the DOF on November 10, 2026, effective November 11. It adds iptacopan, tucatinib 50 mg and 150 mg, a non-invasive temperature management system (531.500.0611), a vacuum-assisted breast biopsy system (531.829.0947) and two nutrition formulas, and modifies entries including atezolizumab, durvalumab, alteplase and semaglutide, whose indication now covers obesity and overweight. The new keys and specifications become the reference for institutional procurement.
noticias.accion: Check whether your products match the new or modified keys and specifications ahead of IMSS, ISSSTE, IMSS-Bienestar and Birmex tenders.

noticias.titulo: COFEPRIS sets priorities for safety-signal management, hospital technovigilance and IoT devices
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS reported on November 10 the results of the 2026 National Pharmacovigilance and Technovigilance Meeting held November 5-6 in Mexico City. Topics included safety-signal management with standardized databases, hospital technovigilance, Internet of Things in medical devices and market-withdrawal procedures. No new obligations or deadlines were announced.
noticias.accion: Registration holders should make sure their adverse-event reporting and recall procedures are up to date.

noticias.titulo: IMSS-Bienestar to transfer MXN 4,761 million to 8,797 primary-care centers for equipment and repairs
noticias.resumen: IMSS-Bienestar announced MXN 4,761 million for 8,797 health centers under the La Clínica es Nuestra program, 314 more units than in 2025. Each center gets MXN 400,000 to 1.2 million depending on its size, and local health committees decide how to spend it, including on clinical instruments, medical equipment, furniture and repairs. Transfers start the week of November 9.
noticias.accion: Distributors of basic medical equipment and instruments should prepare for many small, community-led local purchases that work differently from centralized tenders.

noticias.titulo: ISSSTE reports 97% medicine supply and brings hemodynamics and anesthesia services in-house
noticias.resumen: Before the Chamber of Deputies Health Committee, ISSSTE head Martí Batres reported 97% medicine supply, 712 new hospital beds and more than MXN 7 billion in construction in two years. He said three hospitals were taken back from public-private partnership schemes and that hemodynamics and anesthesia are now run in-house, with endoscopy moving the same way. No equipment-purchase amounts were disclosed.
noticias.accion: Suppliers of hemodynamics, anesthesia and endoscopy equipment should expect ISSSTE to buy directly instead of through outsourced service contracts and adjust their tender strategy.

noticias.titulo: Adulterated lot of Argliptin-D (sitagliptin/metformin) in circulation
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS warned about lot LC89738 of Argliptin-D 50 mg/850 mg, a type 2 diabetes drug, after a visual assessment with the registration holder Mexar Pharma. The lot was not officially imported for sale in Mexico, so its origin and quality cannot be guaranteed; the alert covers only that lot.
noticias.accion: Check pharmacy and hospital stock for lot LC89738, quarantine it and file a sanitary complaint if you find it on sale.

noticias.titulo: Warning on illegal online sales of tirzepatide products
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS, relayed by the Michoacán Health Ministry, warned about tirzepatide products for weight loss and diabetes sold below regulated prices and without prescription on e-commerce sites and apps, as vials, pens, drops, patches and injectables. They may lack the active ingredient, carry wrong doses or contain harmful substances.
noticias.accion: Buy tirzepatide only from authorized distributors with invoices and report online offers of unregistered presentations to COFEPRIS.

fuente.nombre: A Tiempo (citing COFEPRIS and SSM Michoacán)

noticias.titulo: USD 245 million clinical research hub announced in Mexico City, led by Avant Santé
noticias.resumen: Economy Secretary Marcelo Ebrard announced USD 245 million under Plan México for the Distrito Tlalpan health-innovation project. Clinical research company Avant Santé will invest USD 225 million in three stages, including a clinical acceleration center and a unit to import, export, label, store and assemble lab equipment. Tecnológico de Monterrey will add USD 20 million for a predictive-medicine center with UNAM.
noticias.accion: Importers of lab and diagnostic equipment and CRO service providers should evaluate partnership and supply opportunities in the project.

noticias.titulo: IMSS emergency plan: 31,700 extra surgeries and new equipment through February
noticias.resumen: IMSS is running weekend surgery drives under a 12-action emergency plan worth MXN 11.7 billion that runs until February 24, 2027, targeting about 31,700 additional surgeries, mainly cataract, gallbladder, hernia, knee and hip. It made MXN 88 million in direct purchases of wound-care material after supplier defaults, expects 1,321 clinical recliners on November 16 and 15 angiography systems ready by the end of November.
noticias.accion: Suppliers of orthopedic implants, intraocular lenses and surgical consumables should contact IMSS hospital purchasing; delivery reliability is being watched closely.

noticias.titulo: IMSS starts delivering a 2,917-device purchase to its hospitals
noticias.resumen: Under its 120-day plan, IMSS began distributing medical equipment from a purchase of 2,917 devices. The first batch sent 47 units (20 3D ultrasound systems, 17 emergency ECGs and 10 ICU multiparameter monitors) to 39 hospitals in 19 states.
noticias.accion: If you supply imaging, monitoring or cardiology equipment, track IMSS follow-up purchases and service contracts tied to this plan.

noticias.titulo: COFEPRIS registers GO-PEN reusable insulin pen; Mexico is its first market
noticias.resumen: Danish company GO-Pen ApS received a COFEPRIS sanitary registration for GO-PEN, a reusable pen for people using vial insulin. Mexico is the first commercial launch market and Grupo LYBB will be the exclusive importer and distributor. The device already has FDA 510(k) clearance and a CE mark (class IIb).
noticias.accion: Context: new competition in insulin delivery devices for pharmacies and diabetes clinics.

noticias.titulo: Counterfeit KitoCream sold online
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS warned about counterfeit units of KitoCream (pirfenidone 10%), a product it classifies as a medical device, sold online. The fakes have no lot number or expiry date, a dark brown color and no secondary packaging. The alert follows a report by the registration holder, Grupo Medifarma.
noticias.accion: If you sell or stock KitoCream, verify lot and expiry on every unit and buy only from the registration holder or its authorized distributors.

noticias.titulo: How COFEPRIS classifies and reviews AI and software as a medical device
noticias.resumen: Software and AI tools are regulated under the same Class I-III risk system as physical devices. Applicants must show clinical association, analytical and clinical validation, change control for model updates and cybersecurity. Devices already approved by trusted foreign regulators can use an abbreviated pathway with a 30-business-day target. Specific AI rules are still being drafted.
noticias.accion: If you plan to register a software or AI product in Mexico, prepare clinical validation and change-control documentation now and check eligibility for the abbreviated pathway.

noticias.titulo: Health Ministry launches Central Ethics and Research Committee for multi-institution protocols
noticias.resumen: The Ministry of Health launched a Central Ethics and Research Committee coordinated by CCINSHAE, bringing together 19 institutional units to review protocols involving two or more health institutions in a single evaluation. It meets on the second and fourth Wednesday of each month and does not replace COFEPRIS authorization.
noticias.accion: Sponsors, CROs and hospitals running multi-site studies, including device trials, should route eligible protocols through the central committee.

noticias.titulo: Third 2027-2028 tender closes; a fourth will cover the remaining 10%
noticias.resumen: The Ministry of Health and Birmex say nearly 90% of the keys needed for 2027-2028 are now covered. The third tender awarded 673 keys (997.6 million pieces, MXN 34.4 billion), including wound-care, laboratory and radiology supplies; Mexican suppliers won 57% of pieces. A fourth tender is planned before year-end.
noticias.accion: If you lost keys or did not bid, prepare for the fourth tender; winners must sign contracts within 20 days of the award.

noticias.titulo: COFEPRIS joins #MedSafetyWeek to boost adverse-event reporting
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS is taking part in the global #MedSafetyWeek campaign (November 2-8, 2026) to increase reports of suspected adverse effects of medicines and vaccines through VigiRam and VigiVac.
noticias.accion: Context: expect more attention on pharmacovigilance and technovigilance reporting; review that your internal reporting process is up to date.

noticias.titulo: COFEPRIS adds new counterfeit lot to Saizen (somatropin) alert; affected lots failed sterility tests
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS updated its alert on counterfeit Saizen 20 mg (8 mg/mL) prefilled cartridges, adding lot EC179361 (exp. 01/2028), which is not a valid lot released by the company. The alert keeps lots BA054637, BA010812 and KW010374, which failed sterility tests; international notifications also flagged lots BA088217 and AB003660.
noticias.accion: Check stock for these lots, immobilize affected units and buy Saizen only from distributors authorized by the registration holder.

noticias.titulo: COFEPRIS opens consultation to cancel two clinical-laboratory NOMs on control materials and calibration
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS published in the DOF draft cancellations of NOM-077-SSA1-1994 (control materials for clinical pathology laboratories) and NOM-078-SSA1-1994 (calibration standards for clinical laboratory measurements). Comments are open for 60 calendar days from publication, until around December 20. Both standards remain in force until a final cancellation is published.
noticias.accion: IVD distributors and clinical laboratories should decide whether to file comments before the window closes and keep complying with both NOMs meanwhile.

noticias.titulo: Government plans purchase of about 6 billion supply pieces for IMSS-Bienestar
noticias.resumen: The federal government announced the purchase of roughly 6 billion pieces of medicines and supplies for IMSS-Bienestar hospitals, from oncology drugs to wound-care material. It will prioritize direct purchases from manufacturers and reverse auctions, and favor suppliers that meet quality and delivery terms. Details are published at compraconsolidada.salud.gob.mx.
noticias.accion: Track awards and delivery performance on compraconsolidada.salud.gob.mx; on-time delivery will weigh in future awards.

noticias.titulo: COFEPRIS aims to clear 70% of its backlog by December; devices lag behind
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS expects to resolve more than 70% of pending medicine and device applications by December 2026. Responses to device requests rose only 8%, due to a shortage of specialized staff; it hired 70 people, mainly for devices and clinical trials. It also plans broader rules for AI-based devices and a single digital window by 2027.
noticias.accion: If you have device registrations pending, expect delays and keep your dossiers complete to avoid deficiency letters.

noticias.titulo: Counterfeit lots of Riopan, IMMUNORHO and Granulox wound spray
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS issued alerts for counterfeit or altered lots of Riopan gel (lots 12542237 and 12191278), IMMUNORHO 300 µg anti-D immunoglobulin (lot 09b84695, not recognized by Kedrion) and Granulox wound spray (lot 16115143, expiry altered from 2019 to 2026). The alerts apply only to the listed lots.
noticias.accion: Check inventory for these lots, do not dispense them and buy only from suppliers authorized by the registration holder.

noticias.titulo: Counterfeit Synvisc Hylan G-F20 in circulation (lot ARSP005)
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS issued a risk alert for counterfeit Synvisc Hylan G-F20, an intra-articular medical device registered by Sanofi Mexico. Fake units of lot ARSP005 show a February 2026 expiry, while the genuine lot expired in February 2023.
noticias.accion: Check your inventory for lot ARSP005, buy only from distributors authorized by the registration holder and require proof of legal acquisition.

noticias.organismo: Secretaría de Salud / Diario Oficial de la Federación
noticias.titulo: New blood and transfusion standard NOM-253-SSA1-2025 published, with a 180-day transition
noticias.resumen: The Ministry of Health published NOM-253-SSA1-2025 on the therapeutic use of human blood and blood components in the DOF; it takes effect 180 days after publication. Blood banks must run more routine laboratory tests on blood products, each type of blood service gets defined functions, and hospital Transfusion Medicine Committees are strengthened to improve hemovigilance.
noticias.accion: Blood banks, hospitals and suppliers of blood-screening reagents and equipment should compare their testing menus and procedures with the new NOM before the transition ends.

fuente.nombre: Zócalo (citing La Jornada and the DOF)

noticias.titulo: New guidelines for the safe use of medicines and health supplies
noticias.resumen: The Ministry of Health published technical guidelines on the safe use of medicines and health supplies for the National Health System. They are guidance documents and do not by themselves create new obligations or change existing rules.
noticias.accion: Context: hospital clients may update their internal safe-use protocols; no immediate action required.

noticias.titulo: 94.5% of 2027-2028 medical supplies awarded; the rest will be re-tendered
noticias.resumen: The federal government awarded 94.5% of the planned volume of medical and wound-care supplies (group 060) for IMSS, IMSS-Bienestar and ISSSTE for 2027-2028: 646 million pieces worth MXN 12.57 billion across 239 codes, with 135 companies taking part. The remaining 5.5% will go through new procurement before the end of 2026, and awarded contracts must be signed within 20 days.
noticias.accion: If you supply group 060 items and lost codes, watch for the new tenders before year-end; if you won, prepare contract paperwork within the 20-day window.

noticias.titulo: Alerts on illegally sold Sculptra and counterfeit meropenem
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS warned about Sculptra (poly-L-lactic acid, lot A00203) sold illegally online, a counterfeit lot of meropenem 1 g (lot X2MF160A) not imported by the authorized distributor, and a voluntary recall of Sortec 200 mg lot 5CE003A.
noticias.accion: Aesthetic clinics and hospitals should verify the origin of these products and buy only through recognized suppliers.

noticias.titulo: Public viewer for medical device registrations
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS launched a public online viewer to check whether a medical device holds a valid sanitary registration. Registration holders can submit observations on the published information.
noticias.accion: Check that your registrations appear correctly in the viewer and report any error, since buyers now use it to verify products.

noticias.titulo: National Pharmacovigilance and Technovigilance Bulletin 2026-I
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS published its 2026-I bulletin on the surveillance of medicines, vaccines and medical devices, including a chapter on the risk analysis of medical devices. It stresses that more reports about a device do not automatically mean higher risk.
noticias.accion: Context: useful reference for how COFEPRIS interprets device incident reports.
